title: Saudi Arabian Date Tagine
description: A traditional Saudi dish featuring tender meat, sweet dates, and aromatic spices, cooked to perfection in a clay tagine.
instructions: Heat the ghee or oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger, cinnamon, cumin, coriander, turmeric, and salt. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the pitted dates and enough water to cover the meat.
Bring to a boil, then cover the tagine and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falls apart easily.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
